findings.message: Contrast not checked for 4 text element(s) on gradient, image or translucent backgrounds — check those by eye.

With long content (names 2.5 times longer, a 60-character word, 9,999,999): div.stock-name "Leite Integral 1L Leite Integral 1L Lei…" is clipped by its container div.stock-name — the text is longer than its box. Let it wrap (overflow-wrap: anywhere), truncate it with the full value in a title, or give it more room.
div.stock-name "Leite Integral 1L Leite Integral 1L Lei…" cuts long text off with no way to read the rest. Put the full value in a title attribute, or link to where it can be read in full.
